Cheren: I'm very sorry about
all the trouble, ma'am.{VAR BE01}

Bianca: Well, um...
We can clean up...{VAR BE01}

Cheren: I'll be waiting in front of
the Pokémon Research Lab.{VAR BE01}

Bianca: Oh! Wait!
I've gotta go home first.{VAR BE01}
Thanks for having us over!{VAR BE01}

Hm. That sure reminded me of
my first Pokémon battle!{VAR BE01}

Oh, and you know? After a battle,
you need to rest your Pokémon!{VAR BE01}

Mom: I wonder where you'll go next
and what kind of Pokémon you'll meet.
“Mom": Ah, ah, this is...{VAR BE01}
Mom: ...That's a Super Rod, right?{VAR BE01}

Looker: Yes, correct!
It is certainly a Super Rod!{VAR BE01}
Mom: I see...{VAR BE01}
